description: Skelet P10-B: flow inspection and playback UI over qualified flow reads (no new backend)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: new /flows page plus flows-ui source tests only; flow REST/MCP/DB untouched; gallery/boards/lens/search unchanged; no schema, migration, donor import, or permission change? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the UI factually correct: lists /api/v1/flows with version filter and top-level cursor pagination; inspects /api/v1/flows/{id}/steps; renders uri/title/stepCount and position/artifact/kind/title/interaction; steps play in stored order with bounded prev/next; missing interactions read as none recorded, never fabricated?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 5 flows-ui source tests pass; lint/typecheck clean; production build includes /flows; graft build/check green; no mock data; screenshot/hotspot/timestamp absence honestly deferred to artifact evidence and rrweb?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: unrecognized-shape fail-closed; HTTP/network failures announced; loading/empty states; whole-flow denial on unreadable steps preserved server-side; navigation bounds disabled at the ends; no hardcoded credentials?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the P10-B flow player grain: pattern taxonomy, rrweb capture, screenshot overlays, or unrelated refactors? Is the replay boundary honestly documented instead of claimed?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: bearer token from user input only; cross-workspace denial stays server-side with no piecemeal leak; no title oracle in copy; no XSS (no innerHTML/eval); no secrets?

state.change: P10-B flow player: apps/web/app/flows/page.tsx (flow list plus deterministic step inspection/playback over qualified REST) plus apps/web/tests/flows-ui.test.mjs (5 source tests). No backend change.
